description: Implement the four mock-service Lambdas under tools-lambdas/: a shared common/ runtime (router, auth, JSON responses, DynamoDB-backed store with lazy seed), per-service handler.py + routes.py for jira/confluence/github/servicenow ported behavior-equivalent from mahalo-dock, the four seed_data.py copied VERBATIM, and the full offline unit-test suite (pytest + moto). This covers plan steps 1-9. Completes as a working, independently-testable unit with no AWS creds and no deploy. FEAT-002 (CDK) depends on this feature's tools-lambdas/ layout and handler paths.
steps: READ FIRST: docs/.agents/tasks/task3-lambda-reimpl/context.json and this file, then the AUTHORITATIVE docs/.agents/tasks/task3-design.md (full endpoint inventory, id rules, 422-detail-per-route, auth, error handling, DynamoDB table shape). context.json replaces re-exploration — do not re-derive what it states. Port VERBATIM; do not redesign.

Step 1 (scaffold + venv): create empty __init__.py in tools-lambdas/common, tools-lambdas/jira, tools-lambdas/confluence, tools-lambdas/github, tools-lambdas/servicenow, tools-lambdas/tests; create tools-lambdas/requirements-dev.txt pinning pytest and moto (dynamodb/all extra). Create tools-lambdas/.venv (py -3.13 -m venv or python -m venv) and pip install -r tools-lambdas/requirements-dev.txt. The existing tools-lambdas/.gitkeep may remain.

Step 2 (seed copy VERBATIM): Copy-Item each D:/lavakumar.baskaran/LavaCode/AI/mahalo-dock/mock-services/<svc>/seed_data.py to tools-lambdas/<svc>/seed_data.py for jira, confluence, github, servicenow — byte-for-byte, no reformatting. Confirm Get-FileHash equality for all four (incl. github BRANCHES/CONTRIBUTOR_STATS dicts and servicenow _SERVICE_CONTEXT).

Step 3 (common/ runtime): implement tools-lambdas/common/responses.py (json_response(status,body) -> Function-URL shape {statusCode, headers:{content-type:application/json}, body:json.dumps(body)}; error(status,detail) -> body {"detail":detail}); common/auth.py (require_token(request,expected): case-insensitive KEY lookup for x-api-token, EXACT value compare, mismatch/absence -> 401 {"detail":"Invalid API token"}); common/router.py (Request dataclass method/path/path_params/query/json_body/headers; Router registering (METHOD, path_template) with {param} segments + declared int coercion e.g. pr_number non-int -> 422; normalizes Function URL v2 event requestContext.http.method/rawPath/rawQueryString+queryStringParameters/base64-aware JSON body AND falls back to top-level httpMethod/path/queryStringParameters when requestContext.http absent; unmatched -> 404 {"detail":"Not found"}; malformed POST/PUT JSON -> 400 {"detail":"Invalid JSON body"}); common/dynamo_store.py (Store(table_name) over boto3 DynamoDB pk/sk: get/put(record under `data`, or list under `value` for github dict-keyed BRANCHSET/STATS)/query(pk)/count(pk via Query Select=COUNT)/delete/batch_write; lazy seed: check sentinel pk=_meta/sk=seeded, if absent deep-copy seed collections via batched writes then conditional-put sentinel attribute_not_exists(pk); let ClientError propagate for the handler's 503 mapping).

Step 4 (test harness + router/store tests): tools-lambdas/tests/conftest.py with a moto @mock_aws DynamoDB-table fixture (mahalo-mock-* table, pk/sk, PAY_PER_REQUEST) + synthetic Function-URL event builder make_event(method,path,*,query,headers,body,token) + an API-Gateway-shaped builder for the fallback branch. tools-lambdas/tests/test_common_router.py covering path-param extraction, int coercion (bad pr_number -> 422), unmatched-route 404, malformed-body 400, Function-URL-v2 path, top-level httpMethod fallback, and lazy-seed seed-once (no double-seed on a second call).

Step 5 (jira): port tools-lambdas/jira/routes.py from mahalo-dock jira/main.py against Store (/health; /projects GET/POST with id (id|project_id|'PROJ').upper() + 409 + defaults status=active/lead=dev-1; /projects/{id} GET 404 'Project not found'; /projects/{id}/board active-sprint bucketing or {"sprint":null,"columns":{}}; /stories GET filters; /projects/{id}/stories GET filters; /stories/{id} GET + assignee_details + 404 'Story not found'; POST /stories validate project_id+title FIRST->422 {"detail":"Field '<name>' is required"} THEN unknown project->404, new id {proj}-{max+1}, status=todo, empty acceptance_criteria/comments; PUT /stories/{id} apply only non-null + 404; /sprints/{project_id} GET returns ALL sprints for the project key, active sprint gets computed completed_points/total_points; /developers GET). tools-lambdas/jira/handler.py: lambda_handler(event,context) wiring router+require_token (MOCK_JIRA_TOKEN default mock-jira-token-12345) + top-level try/except mapping botocore ClientError->503 {"detail":"Backend store unavailable"} and any other exception->500 {"detail":"Internal error"} (never leak a trace). tools-lambdas/tests/test_jira_handler.py: health(200 no token), auth 401, every read route (seed-derived), create-story->get-story read-after-write, 422-before-404 order, PUT update.

Step 6 (confluence): port tools-lambdas/confluence/routes.py from confluence/main.py (/health; POST /spaces id (id|'SPACE').upper()+409; GET /spaces; GET /spaces/{id} 404 'Space not found'; GET /pages + optional space_id SUMMARY only (no content); GET /spaces/{id}/pages summary; POST /spaces/{id}/pages 404 unknown space, id (id or f"{space_id}-{count(PAGES)+1:03d}").upper() count=Query COUNT over pk=PAGE, defaults title/author/last_updated/content; GET /pages/{id} full+404 'Page not found'; GET /search required q min-len-1 else 422 {"detail":"Field 'q' is required"}, optional space_id, substring over title+content, +/-100 excerpt, relevance 1.0 title/0.7 content, sort desc -> {"results","total","query"}). confluence/handler.py as step 5 with MOCK_CONFLUENCE_TOKEN. tools-lambdas/tests/test_confluence_handler.py: health, auth, list/get/search reads, summary-vs-full trimming, excerpt/relevance, create-page read-after-write, missing-q 422.

Step 7 (github, mock-mode only): port tools-lambdas/github/routes.py from github/main.py + mock_backend.py (DO NOT port gitea_backend.py/backend_base.py). Three collections REPO (record under data) / BRANCHSET sk=repo_id (branch list under value) / STATS sk=repo_id (contributor list under value); branch/commit/pull/readme existence checks key off BRANCHSET (mirror repo_id not in BRANCHES), get_stats off STATS. All sk/repo_id are seed id repo-N, NO name->id resolution. /health mode=os.environ.get('GITHUB_MODE','mock'). POST /repos new id str(name or 'repo').lower().strip(), 409 'Repository already exists', writes REPO + BRANCHSET(default main branch {"name":"main","protected":true,"last_commit":"2026-08-29"}) but NO STATS. GET /repos, GET /repos/{id} 404 'Repository not found'. GET /repos/{id}/branches 404 off BRANCHSET. POST /repos/{id}/branches missing name->422 {"detail":"Field 'name' is required"}, 404 repo, 409 'Branch already exists'. GET /pulls, GET /repos/{id}/pulls, GET /repos/{id}/pulls/{pr_number} int-coerce + 404 'Pull request not found'. POST /repos/{id}/pulls 404 repo, missing head->422 {"detail":"head branch is required"} VERBATIM, id pr-{count(PULL)+1}, number max(existing,0)+1. GET /repos/{id}/commits sorted desc by date. POST /repos/{id}/commits has_files=isinstance(body.get('files'),list) or bool(body.get('path')); required branch,message always + author_id only when NOT has_files (else default mahalo-bot); missing->422 {"detail":"Field '<field>' is required"} VERBATIM; 404 repo then 404 'Branch not found'; author resolved from STATS; id c{count(COMMITS)+1:03d}; date 2026-08-25. POST /repos/{id}/readme 404 repo. GET /repos/{id}/stats 404 off STATS + computed aggregates (active_branches from BRANCHSET, open_prs). github/handler.py with MOCK_GITHUB_TOKEN. tools-lambdas/tests/test_github_handler.py: Task-2 chain create_branch->commit->open_pull, 409/422 'already exists' exact codes+detail, three-collection 404 split (fresh repo 404s on stats but succeeds on branch/commit/pull), count-vs-max ids, health {"mode":"mock"}.

Step 8 (servicenow): port tools-lambdas/servicenow/routes.py from servicenow/main.py (/health; GET /services; GET /deployments filters + sort desc deployed_at; GET /deployments/{id} 404 'Deployment not found'; GET /incidents filters severity/status/service(=affected_service)/assignee + sort desc opened_at; GET /incidents/{id} 404 'Incident not found'; POST /incidents validate title+affected_service FIRST->422 {"detail":"Field '<name>' is required"} THEN unknown service->404 {"detail":"Unknown affected_service"} VERBATIM, id INC-{max(2000,existing max)+1}, defaults status=open/opened_at=now UTC %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ/resolved_at=None; PUT /incidents/{id} apply only provided + set resolved_at on transition to resolved + 404; GET /stats deployments-by-status/open/open-by-severity). servicenow/handler.py with MOCK_SERVICENOW_TOKEN. tools-lambdas/tests/test_servicenow_handler.py: health, auth, deployment/incident reads + sort, create-incident->list read-after-write, unknown-service 404, missing-field 422-before-404, PUT resolve transition, /stats.
Step 9 (suite green): run the whole tools-lambdas/tests suite together offline under moto and confirm all pass with no network calls.
acceptance_criteria: The four seed files are byte-for-byte identical to their mahalo-dock sources: Get-FileHash equality holds for jira/confluence/github/servicenow seed_data.py.

Every service handler enforces the static X-API-Token (401 {"detail":"Invalid API token"} on missing/wrong token; /health exempt) and returns the native mock status codes incl. github 409 'Branch already exists'/'Repository already exists', 422 'head branch is required', 422 "Field '<field>' is required", 404 'Repository not found'/'Branch not found' with exact `detail` strings.

Read-after-write holds via DynamoDB (moto) for all three Task-2 flows: jira create story->get story; github create branch->commit->open PR (with the 409/422 'already exists' path asserted to return those exact codes+detail); servicenow create incident->list.

ID generation matches the mock per field: max-based (jira story, servicenow incident, github PR number) vs count-based (github commit id, github PR id, confluence page fallback id) — asserted by handler tests.
GitHub keys all collections by seed id repo-N with no name->id resolution, and a freshly create_repo'd repo 404s on /stats while succeeding on branch/commit/pull (three-collection split preserved).
`& tools-lambdas/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tools-lambdas/tests -q` passes with no network access and no AWS credentials.
No file under agent/ or mahalo-dock/ is modified; no langchain/langgraph import appears anywhere under tools-lambdas/.

For each svc: (Get-FileHash tools-lambdas/<svc>/seed_data.py).Hash -eq (Get-FileHash D:/lavakumar.baskaran/LavaCode/AI/mahalo-dock/mock-services/<svc>/seed_data.py).Hash -> True for all four
& "tools-lambdas/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" -m pytest tools-lambdas/tests -q -> all tests pass (router/store + four handler suites), offline, no AWS creds
git status shows no modifications under agent/ ; a grep for langchain/langgraph under tools-lambdas returns nothing

All four Get-FileHash seed equalities = True. No langchain/langgraph under tools-lambdas; no agent/ changes.

FEAT-002 (CDK) inputs:
- Handler entrypoints (one per function): jira.handler.lambda_handler, confluence.handler.lambda_handler, github.handler.lambda_handler, servicenow.handler.lambda_handler. Each handler.py reads env at import, lazily builds the Store+Router, calls store.ensure_seeded(), dispatches, and maps botocore ClientError->503 {"detail":"Backend store unavailable"}, any other exception->500 {"detail":"Internal error"}.
- Asset root is tools-lambdas/ (put it on sys.path; Code.from_asset('../tools-lambdas', ...)). Imports are: `from common....` (absolute, asset-root-relative) and within a service package `from . import routes` / `from . import seed_data` (relative). So each function's asset MUST include the common/ dir AND its own service dir.
- common/ asset layout (shared by all four functions): common/__init__.py, common/responses.py (json_response/error + a Decimal->int/float JSON encoder for DynamoDB numbers), common/auth.py (require_token, case-insensitive header-KEY lookup, exact value compare), common/router.py (Request dataclass + Router with {param} segments, declared int coercion e.g. pr_number, Function-URL-v2 normalization + top-level httpMethod fallback, 404 'Not found' / 400 'Invalid JSON body'), common/dynamo_store.py (Store(table_name, seed_items=callable): get/exists/query(pk,attr)/count(pk via Select=COUNT)/put/delete/batch_write; ensure_seeded() uses sentinel pk=_meta/sk=seeded via conditional put attribute_not_exists(pk); lets ClientError propagate).
- Each service dir contains: __init__.py, handler.py, routes.py (exposes seed_items() generator + build_router(store, token)), seed_data.py (VERBATIM mahalo-dock copy).
- Per-function asset exclude list to keep each package minimal (exclude the OTHER three service dirs + tests + venv + caches + dev reqs). For the jira function: exclude=["confluence", "github", "servicenow", "tests", ".venv", "**/__pycache__", "requirements-dev.txt", ".gitkeep"]; analogously per service (keep common/ and the one target service dir). tests/ and requirements-dev.txt are never packaged.
- DynamoDB table per service: names mahalo-mock-jira, mahalo-mock-confluence, mahalo-mock-github, mahalo-mock-servicenow. Key schema pk (S, HASH) + sk (S, RANGE), BillingMode PAY_PER_REQUEST. Convention: pk = collection name, sk = natural id; record stored under attribute `data`, EXCEPT github dict-keyed collections BRANCHSET and STATS which store their per-repo list under attribute `value`. pk values used: jira DEVELOPER/PROJECT/SPRINT/STORY; confluence SPACE/PAGE; github REPO/BRANCHSET/STATS/PULL/COMMIT; servicenow SERVICE/DEPLOYMENT/INCIDENT; plus the seed sentinel pk=_meta sk=seeded. Grant each function read+write on ONLY its own table (table.grant_read_write_data(fn)).
- Env vars CDK must set on each function: TABLE_NAME (the per-service table name) and MOCK_<SVC>_TOKEN. Defaults the handlers fall back to (match agent/config.py): MOCK_JIRA_TOKEN=mock-jira-token-12345, MOCK_CONFLUENCE_TOKEN=mock-confluence-token-12345, MOCK_GITHUB_TOKEN=mock-github-token-12345, MOCK_SERVICENOW_TOKEN=mock-servicenow-token-12345. Do NOT set GITHUB_MODE (github handler defaults it to 'mock', health reports {"mode":"mock"}).
- Runtime: PYTHON_3_13; no third-party runtime deps (boto3/botocore come from the Lambda runtime), so plain lambda.Function + Code.from_asset (no PythonFunction pip bundling). Suggested memory 256MB, timeout 30s per the design.
